marketing_description: The NUVO® by SATCO fixture delivers 2200‑2320 lm at 29 W, operating on 120/277 V with a 0.242/0.105 A rating at 60 Hz and uses a single E26 LED bulb rated at 75 W equivalent. Its contemporary round aluminum housing in a white finish includes a frosted PMMA lens, is dimmable, rated IP20, and measures 19 in diameter with a 19 × 19 × 5 in backplate; the bulb is included.
